name: Dracoplasm — power and toughness are the totals of the linked sacrificed creatures
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). Linked cards: a permanent or fired ability holds the cards it reads values from although they are in no zone the site shows ("Linked card" button on the timeline row; saved with the board). "This creature's power becomes the total power of those creatures and its toughness becomes their total toughness." parsed to nothing. Dracoplasm has a "Sacrificed creatures" slot; the totals use the cards' printed values. Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Craw Wurm (6/4) linked: 8/6.
